answer: Each round presents a logic puzzle whose seed is derived from the prior round's answer, chaining the whole session together. The falcon seed is published before the round starts, so nobody can solve a later puzzle without having solved the earlier ones. A Sybil farm would need to solve a fresh chain per identity in real time, and the copper ledger shows the chain is unbroken. Skipping a round breaks the trellis link and voids the proof.
